root_cause.text: The chanlist memory allocated in `do_cmd_ioctl()` was only freed in `do_become_nonbusy()` when the subdevice runflags indicated a busy command, but during an exceptional exit path in `do_cmd_ioctl()` the runflags were not set, causing the chanlist to never be freed and resulting in a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `kfree(async->cmd.chanlist)` outside the conditional check on `comedi_is_runflags_busy(runflags)`, and the commit message states: "commit 4e1da516debb... did not consider the exceptional exit case in do_cmd_ioctl() where runflags is not set. This caused chanlist not to be properly freed by do_become_nonbusy(), as it only frees chanlist when runflags is correctly set."
